subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The artist received a ___________ from the audience.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"round"** in the context of applause means a burst or series of claps from an audience as a sign of appreciation. (गोल/दौर)

 
 
• **Example: **After the performance, the singer received a loud **round** of applause from the audience.
 
 
 
• **"applause"** refers to the clapping of hands to show approval or admiration. (ताली)
 
 
• **Example: **Her speech was met with thunderous **applause.**
 
 

Hence, the phrase **'round of applause'** is commonly used to describe a collective show of appreciation through clapping.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Plenty of applause** (बहुत सारी तालियाँ): Refers to a large amount of clapping, but it is not a common phrase.

 
 
• **Example:** The artist received plenty of applause, though it is not the usual expression.
 
 
 
• **Bunch of applause** (गुच्छा तालियाँ): This is an incorrect phrase as it is not commonly used in English.
 
 
• **Example: **The phrase 'bunch of applause' is not commonly used.
 
 
 
• **Handful of applause** (थोड़ी सी तालियाँ): This phrase implies a small amount of clapping, which is not suitable in this context.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist received a handful of applause, which means only a few people clapped.
 
 

43:T6d4,
The correct answer is Option 2)</s
